main.text.theVeryFirstCommunityDrivenNFT: The very first community-driven NFT project
main.text.whatIsMindfulOceanDes: Mindful Ocean is the first community-driven NFT project of the same series. Anyone can join in the project by submitting coloring artworks, and in return be rewared with tokens. Try now!
main.text.downloadMindfulOcean: Download Mindful Ocean at App Store to create your own version of fish.
main.text.submitArtworksCreated: Submit artworks created by the Mindful Ocean app to collect Mint Pass. With a Mint Pass, you will be able to redeem your own artwork NFT when they are ready to be minted.
main.text.redeemAndReveal:
Redeem and reveal your own artwork NFT if you own a Mint Pass.
You can get a Mint Pass by submitting an artwork on Mindful Ocean App or purchase directly on OpenSea.
main.text.forEveryNFTSold: For every NFT sold in the Mindful Ocean project, we are going to donate 5% of the profit to The Ocean Clean Up -- a non-profit engineering environmental organization based in the Netherlands. You can contribute and be part of our ocean proteaction program, by simply submit your creations!
main.text.redeemYourMindfulToken: Redeem your Mindful Token after submitting your coloring artworks! With the Token you can vote for the next NGO and fish theme for the coming event!
